summary: Pre-Apple submission testing completed. All core functionality verified: Login flow works, books load correctly (46 books), profile dropdown opens with dynamic tier display ('Basic • 10 books/mo'), pricing page shows all 5 tiers with correct prices, book detail page loads with all buttons. iOS/iPadOS payment modal code reviewed - logic is comprehensive and correctly implemented.

integration_issues.issue: Book detail page takes 8-10 seconds to load after navigation. Initial tests showed infinite loading spinner, but page eventually loads correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: browser.js iOS detection is comprehensive - covers iPhone, iPad, iPadOS 13+ (Mac with touch), userAgentData, and standalone mode
Payment modal correctly uses real <a> tag with target='_blank' for iOS WebView compatibility - this bypasses Apple's restriction on programmatic navigation
openPaymentUrl() only shows modal when BOTH isIOS() AND isNativeApp() are true - regular web browsers redirect normally
App.js has fallback URL: BACKEND_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || 'https://kitab-cloud.emergent.host' - good for iOS builds
Book detail page loading could be optimized - currently waits for authLoading to resolve before fetching book data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Apple rejection bugs verified fixed. iOS/iPadOS payment modal can only be fully tested on real iOS device in Capacitor app - code review confirms logic is correct. Book detail page loads slowly but works.

login_flow.details: Login with test credentials works, redirects to /library

books_loading.details: 46 books loaded successfully on Library page. Console shows '[LibraryPage] Books fetched successfully: 46'

profile_dropdown.details: Dropdown opens on click, shows user info (Huzaifah Waheed, email), tier badge 'Basic • 10 books/mo', Settings link, Logout button, Admin Dashboard link

dynamic_tier_display.details: API /api/tiers returns correct data. Desktop dropdown shows 'Basic • 10 books/mo'.

pricing_page.details: All 5 tiers displayed with correct prices: Pay Per Book, Basic ($20), Standard ($40), Advanced ($60), Premium ($80)

book_detail_page.details: Book detail page loads with title, cover, description, prices, Read Now button, Buy PDF button, Favorite button, Add to Reading List button

ios_payment_modal_code_review.details: browser.js isIOS() function covers: iPhone/iPod UA, iPad UA, MacIntel+touch (iPadOS 13+), userAgentData, Macintosh+touch, standalone mode. Payment modal uses real <a> tag for iOS WebView compatibility.

api_verification./api/auth/login: Returns token and user data correctly
api_verification./api/books/{id}: Returns book details with pdf_url, cover_url, prices
